summary: Provide encrypted communication and settlements for AI agents.
description_long: Erebus creates a shielded infrastructure for agent-to-agent commerce, addressing the critical need for privacy in transactions. It offers relationship privacy, atomic negotiation and settlement, and selective disclosure, ensuring that agents can operate without exposing their transactional relationships. The project implements an encrypted communication channel that moves away from transparent rails, solving challenges in agent interoperability with a focus on security and privacy.
